name: Unnumbered instruction text never escapes the linter
description: Every instruction line the user reads must be linted. Cases here pin that instruction text without step numbers is linted as instruction text - a lone unnumbered doneness claim is a finding, an unnumbered preamble line is linted before the numbered steps, and instruction text that cannot be parsed into lintable lines at all fails closed instead of passing clean (canon clause 7).
